subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR land internal multi-pass compaction machinery before production callers are wired, or should it be narrowed to the currently reachable pruning/summary changes while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398 decides the architecture?
rationale: The branch mixes reachable runtime changes with future architecture code; choosing whether to keep unintegrated core compaction internals is a maintainer product/architecture decision, not a mechanical repair.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the reachable pruning, summary, and cut-point changes only, and defer multi-pass orchestration to the canonical architecture issue until callers and upgrade proof are ready.

options.title: Sponsor the full architecture
options.body: A maintainer explicitly owns the multi-pass design, resolves conflicts, and requires production caller wiring plus upgrade/session-state proof before merge.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the branch open or close it later if maintainers prefer a fresh smaller PR after the architecture decision.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the reachable pruning, summary, and cut-point changes only, and defer multi-pass orchestration to the canonical architecture issue until callers and upgrade proof are ready.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the live PR assignee and therefore the best available owner for the sponsor-vs-narrow choice.
